• Follow the normal greeting routine.

Theme Discussion : All about me - Body parts
• Before school starts, bring in two items related to the theme to show the pupils. Put the items 
in the center of the circle. If no items are available, draw two pictures on the board instead.
• Say: Ke koye xaranñimmen ni ''  A su na do inke ya yi - Haten suhunu ''  sahandu beenu ŋa

activities.title: Writing
activities.content:
Learning Names

• Say: O haayi riini o toxon sahanden ya xara.o bicca gaa a joppana,o na ho kahu o kittun ŋa
• Warm up exercise: have pupils push their palms together as hard as they can for 10 seconds. 
Then release and shake hands for 10 seconds. Repeat two more times.
• Give each pupil their individual name card.
• Have pupils go through the following steps: 
1. Pupils trace the letters on the name card with their fingers.
2. Pupils trace the letters of their name on their desks or on the ground. 
3. Pupils write their name on paper. 
Monitor pupils through each step to make sure they are forming the letters correctly. Provide 
guidance as needed either verbally or by writing the letter(s) for the pupil to trace.

activities.title: Before Reading & Reason to Read
activities.content:
Comprehension: Visualization 
• Say: O simme do gumanŋe ke ga hiibe kamma
• Read the title of the story but do NOT show the illustration.
• Say: A mhaqqilen di natalin dabari an da simma ke be ga do gumanŋe ke yi. An da mani wari? 
• Give the pupils a minute to make the picture in their mind. 
• Turn and Talk: Have pupils turn to the pupil next to them to talk about what they are 
visualizing in their minds. After two minutes, gather pupils back as a group. Choose a good 
example you heard from a pupil, and share it with the class.
• Say: Saasa o na natali ku katu me yi gumanŋe ke di o ni haayi i ga moxobe.

• Show the picture for the story.
• Say: An da mani wari natali ke di a do natali be  gan xawa an paxilen di. 
• Give the pupils a minute to think about what ŋas the same. Then call on a pupil at random 
asking for what they see. Make sure the pupil's description relates to the picture and the 
story.
Learn New Print Concepts
• Say: O ga na xara, o na digaamun baanan baanan xara. Digan gabun ya na gumanŋe ke di o ga 
hibeenu xarana baane baane dere su noxon di. 
• Hold up the book. Read the title slowly and point to each word.
• Call on a pupil at random to come and point to each word of the title as you read.

activities.title: Comprehension: During Reading
activities.content:
Read Aloud (TRANSLATE)  (NEEDS AN ILLUSTRATION)
• Read aloud the story. Point to each word as you read.
Ananse do Jin Siwo
N da xa gumaane.Sambanbiraane gotten be toxon ga ni Ananse. Kinciga baane, daqu da Ananse 
raga. A raqen kaaŋa xa a ŋa lahini mini. Asa ti, i  na kammen  ya dukku. Bari bito dangi halle, 
kamme ma ri. Kiye ke toxo bakka, hanken ŋa wurunu. Xa bari kanmun sennen ni. Ananse pare nan 
daga Ji muuri. A tere kata teenun ŋa nan sege gidun kanma.  A ŋa derun wure haayi haayini na Jin 
saxura muuru xa a ma Jin wari.
Yitte ke wure, Asa da kaaŋafi wari. Jin ŋa siwon di taaxunu motota xasen noxon di. A wuru kata 
non ŋa nan ti n laŋayi minni bakka ke siwo di kanmoxo? Ananse da nxullemme ñan ya na Jin puutu, 
xa bari a raxxen roxen ni. A ma Ji suu kita. Xa a da kocce wutu na a gulla kata pono keyi ta gabe 
Xa a kittun lanpu. Ken suudi  Jin ta no. Ananse ma jigirinkuti. A da karon haayi xa a da koccu 
hunsu yogonu  wutu. A da ŋaraye kita. A da koccu ku baanan baanan yerendi siwon di. Ji ke joppe 
mullin segene. Lagarun ŋa, Ji ke kiñe siwon laxxen ŋa.   Ananse tukayi nan mini ma daxxun ga 
bakka yi. A kaaŋa du ya xibaare ke jarande ŋa.
Ananse noxo hakkan Ñaxalinten daga. A pare xibaare tana da.

activities.title: Comprehension: After Reading
activities.content:
Factual Question: Review All
• Read the title of the story. Call on a pupil at random to answer each of the following factual 
questions:
Question 1: Ananse na mani mundunu? (Jaabinde: Ji)
Question 2: Ananse da Jin wari minna?( Jaabinde: siwon noxon di.)
• After each response, ask the pupil why they gave that answer. Affirm the correct answer or 
attempt, let them know if it is correct, and clarify the answer. Help pupils find the part of the 
story that contains the answer.

Inferential Questions: Main Idea
• Say: Gumanŋe su da xaranñimmen ya bangandi. Diganñimme ke ni gumanŋen ga da hiibe koyi. 
Gumanŋe ke digaamu Ananse ya kamma a  ga Jin muurunu.
• Ask the pupils if they agree.
• Say: Diganñimme ni ''Ananse do siwo'' xo Annse do a ga jin kitta moxobe, ke ña sigi gumanŋe 
ke gabe na a ya kamma a ga Jin muurunu.
Repeat the sentence but prompt pupils to finish the sentence by saying what the story is mostly 
about.

activities.title: Learning Sounds
activities.content:
Sound Matching Game
• Write the letters that have been learned on the board. 
• The letters should be large enough for all pupils to see. Make sure they are evenly spaced out 
in a line that is eye level for the pupils. After writing each letter:
• Say: Ke xotte ni mani ya? A da mani sehexannen ko?
• Call on a pupil at random to answer. Affirm the correct answer or attempt, let them know if it 
is correct, and clarify the answer.
• Put the pupils into pairs and give each pair a letter card (use only the letters that have been 
learned so far). Have the pairs sit in a line facing the board.
• Say: N ga na sehexannen ko a ga da a ñi a me sehante ŋa deren ŋa a maxa, an da a menjanŋe 
da dere ke riiti katta ke be ga ŋalahan ŋa. 
• When pupils go to the board with their letter card, affirm the correct answer or attempt, let 
them know if it is correct, and clarify the answer.
• Go through the letters that have been learned. Assist pupils as needed if they are having 
difficulty connecting the sound said with their letter card.
• As time permits, switch up the letter cards between the pairs of pupils.
